services.title: Roof Inspection
services.short: Detect issues early and extend your roof’s life.
services.text: Thorough inspections to assess the condition of your roof, identify potential issues, and recommend the best solutions to prevent costly damage.
services.imageAlt: Close view of a shingle roof with vents during an inspection
body: We understand that the roof is one of the most critical components of any property. Whether you’re buying a home or working as a real estate agent, a professional roof inspection is essential to avoid unexpected costs and ensure a secure investment.

Roof damage is often not visible to the naked eye, yet it can lead to leaks, structural issues, and costly repairs. Our professional inspection gives a detailed assessment of the roof’s condition, so you can make informed decisions and negotiate with confidence.

For buyers, we help prevent unpleasant surprises and make sure your dream home is in excellent condition. For real estate agents, our inspections add value to your services, giving your clients confidence and making negotiations smoother.
points: Comprehensive evaluation to identify wear, cracks, and potential leaks.
Structural and material assessment to determine remaining lifespan.
Detection of hidden issues that could impact safety and property value.
Personalized recommendations for rehabilitation, repairs, or roof replacement.
Detailed report with photographs and tailored solutions.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get my roof inspected?
faqs.a: We schedule inspections within the same week you contact us. Reach out, and we’ll set it up for a date that works best for you.

faqs.q: How do I know if my roof needs to be repaired or replaced?
faqs.a: The age of the roof, materials, weather exposure, and any specific damage are all considered. The extent of the damage and its impact are also evaluated to determine the best long-term solution.

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Fast, reliable repairs for leaks, cracks and damage.
services.text: Fast and reliable repairs to fix leaks, cracks, and other damages, ensuring your roof remains strong and weather-resistant.
body: A damaged roof can compromise the safety, efficiency, and appearance of your property. At CAP Roofing and Construction, we provide expert roof repair services, with quick and durable solutions for any structural or aesthetic issue.

Your roof is your home’s first line of defense against the elements, and even small issues can turn into costly problems if ignored. Timely repairs help you avoid water damage that leads to mold, rot and structural issues, higher energy bills from poor insulation and leaks, repair costs that grow the longer damage is left, and lost property value and curb appeal.

Consider a repair if your roof has persistent leaks or water stains, if shingles or roofing materials are loose, cracked or missing, if you notice moisture, mold or discoloration on ceilings and walls, or when there are sagging sections or significant wear and tear.
points: Thorough diagnostics to identify visible and hidden issues
Leak sealing and reinforcement to prevent water damage
Replacement of damaged shingles, panels, or materials
Structural corrections to improve roof stability
Gutter and drainage system repairs to prevent water buildup

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement or repair usually take?
faqs.a: Replacements and repairs are completed on the same day. If there are any issues that cause a delay, you will be notified as soon as possible.

services.title: Roof Installation
services.short: New roofs and replacements with top-quality materials.
services.text: Expert roof installation with top-quality materials and precision craftsmanship for long-lasting durability and protection.
services.imageAlt: A roofer laying underlayment over new roof decking
body: Whether for a new construction or a renovation, a properly installed roof is one of the most valuable investments for any property. At CAP Roofing and Construction, we offer custom roofing solutions tailored to your needs and built with top-quality materials.

Consider a new roof if you’re building a new home or commercial property, when your existing roof shows severe deterioration and needs complete replacement, if you want to improve energy efficiency and thermal insulation, or to modernize the look of your property and increase its market value.
points: Superior protection against leaks, extreme weather, and wear
Energy efficiency, reducing heating and cooling costs
Enhanced property value with a functional, good-looking installation
Long-term durability, backed by industry standards and warranties

faqs.q: Do you offer warranties on your work and materials?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer a three-year craftsmanship guarantee; during your consultation, we will give you detailed information on the coverage and terms of this guarantee. For materials, we operate under the manufacturers’ warranties, which may vary depending on the materials selected for your roofing project.

faqs.q: I have questions about my roofing materials, can you help me with that?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our team is well-versed in roofing materials, including asphalt shingles, metal roofing, and tiles, and can explain the benefits, durability, and suitability of each type for your needs and your property.

faqs.q: What steps are involved in the roofing process?
faqs.a: The roofing process typically includes an initial consultation, thorough inspection, material selection, project scheduling, preparation and protection of your property, the installation itself, and a final inspection. We keep you informed and involved at every step.

faqs.q: How will you protect my property during the roofing project?
faqs.a: We cover landscaping, use protective tarps, remove debris promptly, and put safety measures in place to safeguard your home during the roofing process. Our experienced team is trained to minimize any disruption to your property.

services.title: Damage Mitigation
services.short: Rapid response to water, fire and storm damage.
services.text: Proactive solutions to reduce risks from storms, leaks, and structural damage, ensuring your roof withstands harsh conditions.
body: When disaster strikes, every second counts. At CAP Roofing and Construction, we provide damage mitigation services for water, fire, and storm-related incidents, helping minimize destruction and prevent further deterioration. Our rapid response team works to protect your property, eliminate hazards, and prepare it for restoration.

Request mitigation after a storm, flood, or severe water intrusion, following a fire or prolonged exposure to smoke, if you notice excess moisture, mold, or structural weakening, or when walls or roofing materials show cracks, leaks, or dangerous deterioration.
points: Water extraction and structural drying
Moisture elimination to prevent mold and odors
Soot and hazardous residue removal, and deodorization of smoke odors
Temporary sealing, protective tarps and specialized coatings for damaged roof sections
Reinforcement of weakened structures to avoid collapse
Inspections and documentation for insurance damage reports

faqs.a: Unaddressed damage can worsen within hours. Moisture can lead to mold growth and structural weakening, fire residues can cause corrosion and persistent odors, and storm-damaged roofs can pose serious safety risks. Early intervention helps reduce restoration costs.

faqs.q: Will my homeowner's insurance cover the cost of roof repairs or replacement?
faqs.a: In many cases, homeowner’s insurance does cover roof repairs or replacements, particularly if damage is caused by unforeseen events such as storms or accidents. We recommend reviewing your policy and consulting with your insurance provider to understand your coverage.

Your deductible is the amount you are responsible for paying out of pocket before your insurance coverage kicks in. It’s important to talk with your insurance adjuster to understand how your deductible will affect the overall cost of your roofing project.

faqs.q: What should I do with the money I received from my insurance company?
faqs.a: Upon receiving funds from your insurance company, your duty is to provide those funds to the contractor to cover the costs of your roofing project, including any remaining balance based on our prior discussions.

about.title: We are CAP Roofing and Construction
text: CAP Roofing and Construction LLC is a locally owned, family-owned company proudly serving Houston and surrounding areas with professionalism and integrity.

We specialize in navigating insurance claims, ensuring a smooth process from start to finish. Our team delivers expert inspections, reliable repairs, and top-tier roof replacements at competitive prices.

When storms hit, we’re here to protect your home. In addition to roofing, we offer professional fencing solutions and mitigation services to enhance your property’s value and safety. We treat your home like it’s our own, because protecting your loved ones starts with protecting where they live.
